checkedOccurrences.text: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

wikipediaActualReadJa: 市一覧記事はShebarimをJOS7:5の語として掲載し、アイ付近かもしれない場所とするが、部族欄も疑問符付きで現代地点は記さない。
geographyCheckJa: Shebarimが独立地名か、地形を表す語か、アイとの位置関係のいずれも確定できない。
